Many health concerns don't develop overnight. Often, they are linked to small daily habits that gradually affect overall well-being.

• Control cravings

Fatty Liver Awareness
Fatty liver is increasingly seen due to modern lifestyle habits. Early awareness can help reverse it effectively.
Take simple steps:
• Cut down sugar and packaged foods
• Stay active and avoid long sitting hours
• Focus on balanced nutrition
• Improve sleep and manage stress.
Consistency is key to better liver health.
